integrity: Reproducible exact finite tests and an analytic infinite-size proof are included; finite checks are not a substitute for the limiting argument. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only uniform mappings; exact dependence between the two aggregate counts. Classical conditional cyclic-permutation law is prior work. Higher-order entropy asymptotics and extensions to nonuniform maps are unproved. Priority may be implicit in broader archived random-mapping analysis.
title: An order-\(1/n\) information law for uncorrelated fixed-point and cyclic-core counts
